responsibility: Performs IRA hard-register assignment, primarily via graph-coloring over allocno conflicts and, for low-cost modes, via a simpler live-range-based fast allocator. The file owns coloring-only data structures, profitable-hard-register forests, spill and preference cost updates, copy-thread handling, and heuristics for choosing among candidate hard registers, including reload spill-quality queries exposed to later passes. It consumes allocnos, conflicts, costs, and copies from earlier IRA phases and produces final allocno-to-hard-register assignments or spill decisions.
